background: Societe Generale is one of France's three largest banks, a universal bank with French retail networks, a large derivatives-driven investment bank, the Ayvens car-leasing business and banking subsidiaries in Africa and Central Europe.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, with one on a negative outlook, one on positive and one on stable, the bank's last rating move was a two-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The ratings sit well above what the balance sheet shows against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 13.2%, leverage of 4.3% and NSFR of 115% are all in the bottom quarter, and LCR of 146% is below the median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. The only flagged item is a raised profitability target on 21 Sep 2026.
